Ancient Tomb.description:
A silent chamber of white stone. In the center lies the golden sarcophagus where Golden Bat slept for 10,000 years.
[marie3]Marie sits in the corner of the tomb, weeping...

secrets.text: You walk to the back of the tomb and see a small crack in the wall, leading north to some secret room...

Echoing Gallery.description:
The room is filled with ancient wooden frames.
Instead of statues, you see a series of painted boards depicting a golden figure saving children from monsters.
A faint smell of candy fills the air — a memory of the sweets sold to children before the show began.
A plaque reads: 'Before the screen, there was the paper. Before the comic, there was the street...'

Secret Tunnel.description: A narrow, damp passageway lit by faint bioluminescent moss. It connects the tomb to the surface ruins...

Shipwrecked Beach.description: White sands littered with the wreckage of Professor Mire's ship. The Pacific waves crash against jagged rocks...

Ocean-Facing Cliffs.description: High, windswept precipices overlooking the vast ocean. From here, you can see the faint glimmer of the lost city below...

Abandoned Residential District.description: Crumbling stone houses that once housed the people of Atlantis. Vines choke the ancient architecture...

Rusted Armory.description: A chamber filled with decayed bronze weapons and empty racks that once held the military might of a lost empire...

Abandoned Church.description: A towering structure with vaulted ceilings. Ancient symbols are carved into the stone...

Church Cellar.description: A dark, cramped basement filled with crates of old scrolls and strange, humming minerals...

Ancient Atlantean Lab.description: A massive hall filled with advanced machinery and glowing crystalline computers from a forgotten science...

Submerged Observation Deck.description: A glass-domed room beneath the waves. You can see the aquatic life of Atlantis swimming past the reinforced glass...
